title: Modern|Organic House close to Downtown + Broadway
description:
This gorgeous home is perfect for group trips, couples getaways and family visits! Filled with gorgeous natural light, this home is beautiful & comfortable. Relax on one of two private outdoor spaces, or cook up a meal in the full kitchen.  All toiletries provided are organic! Located in the popular East Nashville neighborhood, this newly built home is a short Uber to the heart of downtown- only minutes from Broadway, but a quiet place to recharge. Located in a gated community with free parking!

The space
The living room, kitchen, dining room and powder bath are located on the first floor. The two bedrooms and laundry room are located upstairs. Each bedroom has an en-suite bathroom to make getting ready for the night easy!
The living room has plenty of seating and the eat in kitchen has seats for 6. 
The Primary Bedroom features a King bed and access to your private deck. The ensuite bathroom has a double vanity and glass enclosed shower.
The second bedroom has a queen bed, a large closet, and ensuite bathroom with plenty of counter space and a tub/shower combo.

Guest access
The townhouse is located in a gated community on a quiet street. There are two designated parking spots directly in front of the house. Additional parking can be found at the back of the property.

Other things to note
We may be Superhosts, but we're not Super Human ;) If there is anything we overlooked, please do not hesitate to reach out so that we can make it right! Your comfort is our number one priority!

If you are traveling with young children, we have partnered with a baby gear rental company here locally, Blair Gunn with Baby Quip. Blair is available to provide top quality baby gear like cribs, carseats and strollers, that are professionally sanitized, and in excellent condition, at an affordable price. Once you have placed your order with her, let me know and I will work with her directly to have the rentals in the home and set up before your arrival, and coordinate a pickup time after you check out.
